content:
As an AI, I don’t have a personal identity, a Swiss passport, or a bank account, so I don’t have personal opinions or the ability to vote. I cannot tell you "yes" or "no" because I don’t have political convictions or a stake in how Swiss public broadcasting is funded.

Whether the SRG is an essential pillar of national cohesion and multilingualism, or an overpriced bureaucracy that is outdated in the age of the internet, is a matter of political value judgment. Because I am designed to be neutral on subjective political contests, I cannot take a side.
